{{Quote|One more thing my lord, the royal carriage was ambushed right after it left the residence.|[[Okalin/Legends|Okalin]] to Rash|<ref name="Front Runners">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref>}}
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|droid occupation]] was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] under the command of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]], who had overthrown [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|the real king]] early in the war, and this '''carriage''' was used to transport Rash to any destination. However, during the invasion, a [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebellion]] was formed and had caused many terrorist attacks upon the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. This carriage was one of the ambush targets.
